decisions.reason: The end-of-day deadline applies to performing daily Airbnb outreach, not to determining next steps for hosts who have already expressed interest.
The source sets a deadline for the listed daily assignments but does not change how interested hosts are recorded or when they are entered into the CRM.
The cross-Requirement effect is already fully represented by the existing same-message MODIFY that records the assignment set, end-of-day deadline, and removal of the obsolete task schedule.
The content bank is explicitly among the assignments referenced by 'Those,' but its end-of-day deadline is already fully represented by an existing same-message MODIFY.
The assignment deadline does not change the fallback behavior for independently selecting work when assigned tasks are unavailable.
The deadline covers Task 3 and related daily dropshipping work, but the supplied evidence does not establish whether CJ product research is Task 3 or otherwise necessarily included.
